submissions.title: Bemidji adopts 1-year moratorium on data center development
submissions.excerpt: Bemidji Planning Board voted 6-1 to prohibit new data center developments larger than 10,000 square feet.
submissions.note: SITING RESTRICTION: Bemidji / Beltrami County, Minnesota adopted a 1-year moratorium (Planning Board vote 6-1, Sept 14, 2026) on new data center developments over 10,000 sq ft, also covering crypto-mining facilities of any size. No tracked project currently sits in this jurisdiction -- flagging as a new prohibition zone for the siting-restrictions map. Corroborated by KAXE, Blandin on Broadband, and the Bemidji Pioneer. submissions.title: Richmond approves pause on developing new data centers
submissions.excerpt: Richmond City Council passed a 45-day moratorium on new data center development in a 6-1 vote.
submissions.note: SITING RESTRICTION: Richmond, CA (Bay Area) approved a 45-day data center moratorium Sept 16, 2026 -- the third Bay Area city after Oakley and Gilroy. City staff say there are no pending data center applications in Richmond currently, so no immediate MW-at-risk change, but it adds to a fast-growing wave of California local moratoriums this month. Related and possibly worth a follow-up next cycle: San Francisco's Board of Supervisors weighed its own 45-day freeze on Sept 15 (needs a 4/5 supermajority under Govt Code 65858); I could not confirm the outcome of that vote -- see end-of-run notes.
